oracle_price_stale_at_market_creation.meaning: the pull-based oracle price is stale (lagging) at the time a market is created
oracle_price_stale_at_market_creation.checkpoint: before market creation reads the oracle price

market_creation_updates_oracle_consisten.meaning: market creation updates the oracle consistently with post-creation user flows (mint/redeem/swap) that update the oracle first

post_creation_flow_updates_oracle_first.meaning: post-creation user flows (mint/redeem/swap) update the oracle first

deterministic_arbitrage_unlocked.meaning: a state-changing action (mint/redeem/swap) is immediately invoked, updates to the correct price, and unlocks a deterministic arbitrage of the mispricing
deterministic_arbitrage_unlocked.checkpoint: after market creation, upon immediate post-creation state-changing action

unresolved.description: The intent states market creation must update the oracle consistently with post-creation flows; the report does not give a numeric or field-level oracle value to compare, so the correspondence is encoded with grounded Boolean observables rather than concrete price values.

limitations: Oracle price staleness and consistency are represented as grounded Boolean observables because the report provides no concrete price values or numeric thresholds.
The impact is potential; the impact_outcome Boolean records the reported unlocked-arbitrage outcome without asserting it as inevitable.
